title: Legal PA
description:
An exciting opportunity for an experienced Legal PA to provide first-class support to a busy, successful dispute resolution team in the heart of Guildford. You will take real ownership of your work, benefit from a supportive and friendly culture, and have genuine opportunities to grow your career.

Company Benefits:
- Annual bonus scheme
- Private medical cover
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- 5% employer pension contribution
- Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental and adoption leave

Key Responsibilities:
- Prepare correspondence and documents, including transcribing digital dictation
- Manage your fee earners diaries, arranging appointments and meetings
- Progress client matters independently, including in the absence of a fee earner
- Welcome and support clients in person and by telephone, delivering a professional and friendly service in line with the firm s standards for client care
- Administer filing, including opening, closing, storing and retrieving client files in line with office procedures
- Prepare mail and enclosures for dispatch and arrange copying as required
- Operate the case management system and complete online forms
- Prepare meeting rooms and provide refreshments for client meetings where appropriate
- Support fellow PAs and secretaries, and guide junior and temporary secretaries when needed
- Maintain the confidentiality of all firm and client information
- Suggest and help introduce improvements to the efficiency of the department
- Undertake training as required and take ownership of your own development

Experience and Skills Requirements
- Substantial legal secretarial experience, including at least 2 years in dispute resolution (Legal Secretary or Senior Secretary level will be considered if less experienced in dispute resolution)
- Excellent touch-typing speed with high accuracy
- Advanced IT skills
- A very good understanding of how fee earners like to work, and the ability to keep up with their work production
- A proactive approach and positive attitude
- Excellent client service, with the ability to engage well with internal and external clients
- Able to work to deadlines, cope under pressure, prioritise effectively and work as part of a team
- Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills, with a high level of courtesy and respect
- Commitment to the firm, a genuine interest in legal work and willingness to take on other tasks as required
- Experience of case management systems
- Knowledge of law and legal practice

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

title: Legal Personal Assistant
description:
Legal Personal Assistant

Job Type: Full-time
Location: Guildford, Surrey
Salary: Up to £32,944

Brief description: An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Legal PA to join a well-established and highly regarded law firm. This Legal PA position would suit someone with strong legal secretarial experience, excellent organisational skills and the confidence to work proactively in a fast-paced litigation environment.

A respected legal practice is seeking a Legal PA to provide high-quality support to fee earners within its Dispute Resolution team. The role is ideal for someone with previous litigation or contentious matters experience who can manage diaries, documents, emails and client communication with a high level of professionalism and initiative.

Day-to-day of the role
- Prepare correspondence, legal documents and digital dictation accurately and efficiently.
- Manage diaries, appointments and meetings for fee earners, ensuring schedules are well organised.
- Support the progression of client matters, including handling routine tasks with minimal supervision where appropriate.
- Liaise with clients in person and by telephone, delivering a professional and friendly service at all times.
- Maintain filing systems, including opening, closing, storing and retrieving client files in line with procedures.
- Use the case management system and complete online forms and administrative tasks as required.
- Assist with post, copying, meeting room preparation and general departmental support.
- Provide cover and support to other secretarial colleagues and offer guidance to junior or temporary staff when needed.
- Help improve departmental efficiency by identifying practical ways of streamlining processes.
- Maintain strict confidentiality in relation to client and firm information.

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Substantial legal secretarial experience, including at least 2 years' experience within dispute resolution for a Legal PA level role.
- Experience within litigation or other contentious legal work would be highly advantageous.
- Excellent audio typing and touch-typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
- Strong IT skills, including confidence using case management systems; previous experience with Practice Evolve would be beneficial.
- Ability to manage a busy workload, work to deadlines and remain calm under pressure.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to use initiative and anticipate the needs of fee earners.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a professional and courteous manner.
- A genuine interest in legal work and a commitment to high standards of client service.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.

Benefits
- Competitive salary with annual salary review and annual bonus scheme.
- 5% employer pension contribution and life assurance/death in service benefit.
- Private medical cover and company sick pay.
- Interest-free season ticket loan and Cycle to Work scheme.
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays.
- Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental and adoption benefits.
- Employee Assistance Programme, wellbeing initiatives and regular socials.

How to apply

To apply for this Legal PA opportunity, please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, particularly within dispute resolution or litigation support, and why this role is of interest to you to Mark Watts, At Reed Legal - your local legal recruitment expert.

title: Paralegal (Corporate & Commercial)
description:
Our client is a well-established and growing law firm seeking an ambitious Paralegal to join their team. This role would suit a candidate with at least one year's experience supporting commercial or transactional legal matters who is looking to further develop their career within a supportive and professional environment.

Working closely with experienced legal professionals, the successful candidate will gain exposure to a broad range of matters, supporting fee earners with legal documentation, transactions, compliance requirements and client matters.

Company Benefits:
- Competitive salary package.
- Generous benefits scheme.
- Structured career development programme.
- Ongoing technical training and professional development.
- Clear progression opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Regular performance reviews and feedback.

Key Responsibilities:
- Reviewing, drafting and amending a variety of legal documents, agreements and transaction-related documentation.
- Assisting with transactions and legal matters from instruction through to completion.
- Conducting due diligence exercises, document reviews and legal research.
- Managing documentation, data rooms and transaction records.
- Preparing meeting notes, resolutions, filings and supporting documents.
- Assisting with regulatory and compliance requirements, including client onboarding procedures.
- Maintaining accurate file management, document control and record-keeping practices.
- Supporting fee earners with client matters, legal administration and project management activities.
- Assisting with business development initiatives, including the preparation of articles, marketing content and client communications.
- Recording time accurately and supporting billing and financial administration processes where required.

Experience and Skills Requirements
- Minimum of one year's experience within commercial, transactional or business-related legal matters.
- Experience reviewing, drafting and amending legal documentation and agreements.
- Experience supporting transactions, due diligence exercises and document management processes.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- High attention to detail and strong administrative abilities.
- Ability to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Strong legal research and analytical skills.
- Understanding of compliance, confidentiality and file management requirements.
- Professional, proactive and client-focused approach.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.

- Drafting legal documents and correspondence.
- Opening and managing client files.
- Conducting searches and reviewing title documentation.

- Liaising with borrowers, lenders, brokers, solicitors and other third parties.

- Understanding of secured lending transactions and the property conveyancing process.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems.

title: Paralegal (Property)
description:

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting fee earners with a wide range of commercial property transactions and matters.

- Confident communicator with a client-focused approach
- Good IT skills and ability to manage competing deadlines
- Proactive, reliable and able to work effectively as part of a team
